name: Popup Builder
description: Site-wide promotional and announcement popups injected on every public page. Triggers (delay, scroll depth, exit intent), frequency capping (always / session / visitor / daily), optional scheduling window, and view/click statistics with CTR.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: List popups and read the active popup with its stats (own prefixed tables only).
Create/update/delete popups and increment view/click counters (own prefixed tables only).
Register the popup API endpoints under /api/v1/plugin/popup-builder/*.
Add the Popups manager to the admin sidebar.
Enqueue the popup script and stylesheet on public pages so the active popup can render site-wide.
